title: 第9章 姐妹相争第10章 抓鬼
content_zh:
王琳惊讶地问：“姐，你怎么来了？”
“哼，我再不来，你们就睡到一起了！”
王艳气哼哼地拿起衬衫套在王琳身上，然后拉着她的手往外走，
“走，你跟我回去！”
“我不走！我跟叶开打赌，叶开输了还没磕头呢！”
“简直是胡闹！”王艳力气比王琳大，连拉带拽把王琳弄走了。
回到家，王艳把大门关上，训斥起王琳：
“你想干什么？你一个女孩子家，跑到人家里，还脱衣服，你还要不要脸？”
王琳很不服气地反驳：“我怎么了，我没有男朋友，叶开也是单身，就算我们在一起也是正常的！”
“你知道他是憨子吗，你跟他在一起，以后怎么生活？”
“凭什么你能跟他在一起，我不能？”
“你说什么，我啥时跟他在一起了？”
“你就别嘴硬了，我昨晚都听见了！”
“你听见什么了？”
“你们动静那么大，就算是个聋子也能听见。”
王艳虽然脸皮厚，听见自己妹妹这么说，脸也红了。
“你不要乱说，要是被外人听见可不得了！”
“你放心，你是我亲姐，我不会说的。”
“姐姐我不容易，嫁给一个没用的男人，这三年来，我跟守活寡差不多，我恨不能死了算了……”
说到伤心处，王艳流下了泪水。

王琳轻轻拍着王艳的肩膀，“姐，我知道你不容易，这几年受了很多的苦，叶开挺不错的，你就跟他好吧。”
“妹妹，你真的这么想？”王艳简直不相信自己的耳朵。
“真的，咱们都是女人，我支持你追求自己的幸福。”
“那你可不能跟叶开好！”
“为什么？”
“我跟他好，你就不能跟他好。”
“这是两码事，我们可以竞争。”
“你还是好好读书，毕业后找份好工作，再嫁个有钱的人家，省的像姐姐我受这份罪。”
“好啦，好啦，别唠叨啦，我要出去玩了。”
“你去哪里，是不是还要找叶开？”
“不找他，我就在村里转一转。”
“你可不能再找他了，你要是再找他，我就不认你这个妹妹！”
“我怕了你了，行了吧？”
王琳走出大门，王艳跟在后边看着王琳往村南走去，这才放了心，回到家里炖鸡汤，准备午饭。
王琳在村里兜了一圈，又来到叶开家，发现大门上已经上了锁。
王琳走进东边邻居家，孙红霞正在院子里忙活，她穿着一身碎花衣裤，虽然不紧身，那曲线玲珑可见。
王琳一看，呀，这村姑挺漂亮的嘛，身材也很火辣啊！
不禁泛起了嘀咕，她住叶开家隔壁，不知两人关系怎么样。
content_en:
Wang Lin asked in surprise: "Sister, why are you here?"
"Humph, if I don't come, you will sleep together!"
Wang Yan angrily picked up the shirt and put it on Wang Lin, then took her hand and walked out.
"Let's go back with me!"
"I won't leave! I made a bet with Ye Kai, and Ye Kai didn't kowtow even if he lost!"
"This is nonsense!" Wang Yan was stronger than Wang Lin, and she pulled Wang Lin away.
After returning home, Wang Yan closed the door and scolded Wang Lin:
"What do you want to do? You, a girl, run into someone else's house and take off your clothes. How shameless are you?"
Wang Lin retorted unconvincingly: "What's wrong with me? I don't have a boyfriend. Ye Kai is also single. Even if we are together, it's normal!"
"Do you know he is a fool? How will you live with him in the future?"
"Why can you be with him but I can't?"
"What did you say? When did I get together with him?"
"Stop being so harsh, I heard it all last night!"
"What did you hear?"
"You are so loud that even a deaf person can hear you."
Although Wang Yan was thick-skinned, she blushed when she heard her sister say this.
"Don't talk nonsense, it will be terrible if outsiders hear it!"
"Don't worry, you are my sister, I won't say anything."
"Sister, it's not easy for me. Marrying a useless man has been like a widow for the past three years. I wish I could just die..."
Speaking of sadness, Wang Yan shed tears.
Wang Lin gently patted Wang Yan on the shoulder, "Sister, I know it's not easy for you. You have suffered a lot in the past few years. Ye Kai is pretty good, so just stay with him."
"Sister, do you really think so?" Wang Yan simply couldn't believe her ears.
"Really, we are all women, and I support you in pursuing your own happiness."
"Then you can't get along with Ye Kai!"
"Why?"
"I'm good with him, but you can't be good with him."
"It's two different things and we can compete."
"You'd better study hard, find a good job after graduation, and marry into a rich family, so that you don't suffer the same fate as my sister and me."
"Okay, okay, stop nagging, I'm going out to play."
"Where are you going? Are you still looking for Ye Kai?"
"If you don't look for him, I'll just walk around the village."
"You can't look for him again. If you look for him again, I won't recognize you as my sister!"
"I'm scared of you, okay?"
Wang Lin walked out of the door, and Wang Yan followed and watched Wang Lin walk to the south of the village. Then she felt relieved and returned home to stew chicken soup and prepare lunch.
Wang Lin walked around the village and came to Ye Kai's house again, and found that the door was locked.
Wang Lin walked into her neighbor's house to the east. Sun Hongxia was busy working in the yard. She was wearing a floral dress. Although it was not tight, her curves were visible.
Wang Lin took a look and said, ah, this village girl is quite beautiful and has a very hot figure!
I couldn't help but murmur that she lived next door to Ye Kai's house and I wonder what their relationship was like.
